summary: Extended the cluster harness with two decision-formation cases and submitted them as a follow-up basis (previous_id the contrast revision): batched_mixed_proposals (batch_size 4, eight entries proposed on the leader and eight on a follower; checks identical decided vectors, exact proposed-value coverage and index/content consistency on every node) and leader_change_prefix (decided prefix, leader removed, replacement elected, further entries, old leader recovered from persisted storage; checks prefix preservation and identical vectors). Both ran locally with their declared properties holding, and the existing stale-decided case still reproduces its abort; five comparisons and their admissions are declared so the run can answer the reported-accepted-index and adoption questions.
